svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The number of wars divided by the number of all states. This accounts for the changing number of states over
time. Included are interstate, intrastate, extrastate, and non-state wars that were ongoing that year.

tspan.tspan: Correlates of War - Wars (2020); Correlates of War - State System Membership (2017)
Some wars affect several regions. The sum across all regions can therefore be higher than the global number.
